phrase.zh: 简单规则，也能提出深的问题。
phrase.en: Simple rules can ask deep questions.

visual.zh: 人物面前延伸出纸带和离散符号，用可触的物件表现抽象计算。人物是风格化肖像，纸带并非可运行的图灵机程序。
visual.en: A stylized figure faces a tape of discrete symbols, giving abstract computation a tangible form. The tape is not an executable Turing-machine program.

background.zh: 图灵在 1936 年的论文中提出一种读写符号的抽象机器，用它探讨什么可以由明确步骤计算。他还说明一台通用机器如何按描述模拟其他机器；理论模型不等于当时已造出的实体计算机。
background.en: In a 1936 paper, Turing used an abstract symbol-reading and writing machine to examine what definite procedures can compute. He also described a universal machine able to simulate others from their descriptions; the model was not a physical computer built at that time.
